patch.value: GH-1177: Claude session provenance path is derived from invocation cwd instead of the session-start workspace

GitHub issue #1177 reproduces on pm-cli 2026.9.2: readClaudeSessionProvenance derives ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl from the current invocation cwd, but Claude fixes the transcript directory to the session-start workspace. Package, monorepo, and fleet subdirectory invocations therefore miss the existing transcript and permanently record null model/version provenance while the parser itself succeeds whenever the path resolves.

Resolve the transcript by explicit harness path when available or bounded unique session-id discovery independent of cwd; distinguish resolver_input_missing from resolver_failed without exposing paths, prompts, identifiers, or session content; prove child-workspace and session-root invocation parity with independent fixtures and a real-layout temporary acceptance; define a justified sustained zero-success health severity; pass provenance, SDK, CLI, security, static, and exact coverage gates.
pm-cli 2026.9.2 under Claude Code when pm runs below the session-start directory

Start Claude in a workspace root, invoke pm from a child repository, compare the cwd-derived transcript path with the unique session JSONL under ~/.claude/projects/*, and observe provenance_resolver_zero_success with null model/version.

The resolver locates the unique session transcript independently of the invocation cwd, remains privacy and resource bounded, and distinguishes missing resolver input from a parsed stream with no supported value.
The resolver encodes the invocation cwd, opens a nonexistent path, catches the filesystem error as undefined, and reports the same advisory outcome as a successful parse with no match.
SDK agent provenance resolver and health diagnostics
Fleet and monorepo histories permanently lose model/runtime attribution while health remains advisory and non-actionable.
